children: Our Bureau Mumbai: Jio Platforms' mega initial public offering (IPO), the largest in Indian corporate history, drew aggregate bids worth about 7.41 lakh crore, closing on Friday with an overall subscription of 22.19 times in public bids. The strong response, especially from institutional investors, was in sharp contrast to the weak secondary-market sentiment amid mounting concerns over elevated crude oil prices and foreign-fund selling.

Investors across categories sought to buy 4.38 billion shares in public bids, against 197.5 million shares on offer, combined data from both stock exchanges showed. Public bids over the past three days totalled 4.91 lakh crore at the higher end of the price band at 1,119 a share. The public issue, which had opened Wednesday, closed for subscription Friday. The stock would list on October 28.

title: Friday Blockbuster for Jio IPO: 7.4Lcr Bids, 22x Subscription
